This is the `swear01/hapi` maintained build based on official HAPI `v0.23.4`, plus upstream `main` through [`deb5d636`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/commit/deb5d63695cd68a1c12b468d2f321f6445b1d819).

## Compared with the previous maintained release (`v0.23.4.2`)

- Added the full 26-commit implementation from [PR #958](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/958): cross-flavor inline image and video display through MCP and ACP, including ordering, provenance, media sniffing, permissions, Cursor overlay safety, OpenCode discovery, Grok/Kimi handling, generated-media caching, and doctor coverage.
- Updated to the latest upstream `main`, where PR #1175 is now merged.
- Reconciled #958 with the maintained fork's existing generated-image and ACP behavior.

## Upstream PR audit policy correction

A PR is no longer deferred merely because it is large. Broad fix collections are eligible when they solve multiple concrete problems, have green checks, fit the maintained product, and can be integrated with full validation. Draft, dirty, failing, conflicting, irrelevant, or exclusion-policy PRs remain defer/drop candidates.

## Compared with the official release (`tiann/hapi v0.23.4`)

This build includes upstream `main` through `deb5d636`, PR #958, and the existing maintained patch set. Codex local-session import remains excluded.

## Maintained-fork guarantees

- Release tags must point to commits contained in `main` and match the four-part CLI version.
- macOS binaries are signed with the stable `xyz.hapi.cli` identity.
- Fork builds do not publish over upstream GitHub Pages or update the upstream Homebrew formula.
- The app shell is served with no-store cache headers.
